name: Iacocca Global Leadership Intensive (IGLI)
what_you_do: A three-week program where you live on campus with teens from around the world. Pick Business and Entrepreneurship or Health and Innovation, and work on team projects.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 to 17 for the whole program. You must finish high school in 2027 or 2028. You need three people to write for you: an English teacher, a second teacher and a counselor.
pay_detail: $7,400 program fee (2027) for tuition, room and board, materials and trips. Small need-based aid, for priority applicants only.
deadline_text: The page says 2027 applications open in October 2026; the form was not active on Oct 22. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027, then rolling.
how_to_apply: Fill out the survey to see if you qualify and name your recommenders. Then send the application with a resume, a one-page essay and a 3-minute video. Questions: globalprecollege@lehigh.edu.
notes: This used to be called IGEI. The old link now goes to the IGLI page. You live on campus and stay the whole time.
